# Plain metadata

These are the only columns One stores without encryption. Every other column holds ciphertext under the person's keys.

Encrypted column type: `bytea`

| Column | SQL type | Kind | Values | Basis | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `owner` | `text` | identity |  | PV-6 | account identifier (PartyRef id), the scope prefix of every key |
| `id` | `uuid` | identity |  | OP-4 (2) | opaque UUIDv7 row id; its time part equals what recorded_at shows |
| `retention_class` | `text` | class | `one_memory`, `one_model`, `one_observation`, `one_sensitive`, `one_provider_trace`, `one_browser_profile`, `one_training_lineage` | PV-6 | retention class accessed |
| `region` | `text` | class |  | PV-6 | region |
| `recorded_at` | `timestamptz` | time |  | PV-6 | write time |
| `deleted_at` | `timestamptz` | time |  | OP-4 (2) | soft delete |
| `version` | `integer` | version |  | OP-4 (2) | record version |
| `supersedes` | `uuid` | version |  | OP-4 (2) | previous version row |
| `status` | `text` | status | `active`, `superseded`, `deleted` | OP-4 (2) | general row status only; the memory lifecycle stays encrypted |
| `record_key_id` | `uuid` | crypto |  | OP-4 (2) | record key id, for shred |
| `wrapped_record_key` | `bytea` | crypto |  | OP-4 (2) | record key wrapped to the class DEK (AES-256 Key Wrap, 40 bytes) |
| `dek_id` | `uuid` | crypto |  | OP-4 (2) | class DEK id |
| `kek_id` | `text` | crypto |  | OP-4 (2) | KEK id the DEK is wrapped to |
| `ciphertext` | `bytea` | crypto |  | PV-6 | nonce and AES-256-GCM ciphertext of the encrypted fields |
| `ciphertext_len` | `integer` | crypto |  | PV-6 | record size |
| `promise_version` | `integer` | crypto |  | PV-19 | privacy promise version the record was collected under |
| `source_id` | `uuid` | derived |  | OP-5 | source row of a derived part |
| `source_version` | `integer` | derived |  | OP-5 | source version of a derived part |
| `embedding_model` | `text` | derived |  | OP-5 | model that produced a vector part |
| `embedding_model_version` | `text` | derived |  | OP-5 | version of that model |
| `index_part_no` | `integer` | derived |  | OP-5 | encrypted index part number |
| `job_id` | `uuid` | queue |  | T-27 (7) | job row id |
| `job_kind` | `text` | queue | `consolidation`, `personal_training`, `reembedding`, `export`, `shred` | T-27 (7) | job kind |
| `state` | `text` | queue |  | T-27 (7) | job state |
| `attempts` | `integer` | queue |  | T-27 (7) | attempt count |
| `run_after` | `timestamptz` | queue |  | T-27 (7) | earliest run time |
| `lease_until` | `timestamptz` | queue |  | T-27 (7) | lease end |
| `permission_id` | `uuid` | queue |  | PV-65 | key permission the job runs under |
| `idempotency_key` | `bytea` | queue |  | T-27 (6) | SHA-256 of the idempotency key |
| `event_type` | `text` | queue |  | OP-3 | outbox CloudEvent type |

## Never a column

These names live only inside the ciphertext.

| Name | Basis |
|---|---|
| `domain` | OP-4 (1) |
| `data_class` | OP-4 (1) |
| `provenance` | OP-4 (1) |
| `produced_by` | OP-4 (1) |

## What the plain metadata still shows

- **one_sensitive retention class** (PV-6): Seeing rows of the one_sensitive class shows that the user turned on a sensitive area; PV-6 allows the class to be visible.

## Rules

- `unlisted-plain-column`: A column not listed here is encrypted and must be bytea.
- `listed-type`: A listed column has exactly its listed SQL type and, where values are listed, a CHECK over them.
- `encrypted-only`: An encrypted-only name never appears as a plain column; it lives inside the ciphertext.
- `closed`: The list is not extended (OP-5); SEC-30 is generated from this file in Turkish and English.
